Markets.title: Axiscades Technologies rises 5% as Sunil Singhania's Abakkus buys 3.03% stake
Markets.summary: Axiscades Technologies shares rose 5% after Abakkus Asset Manager and Kotak Mahindra Mutual Fund acquired significant stakes in the company through block deals. Promoter Jupiter Capital sold a 10.69% stake for Rs 829.72 crore as part of the transaction.

Markets.title: Q2 earnings: Can India Inc repeat Q1, or will Q3 erase the base-effect tailwind?
Markets.summary: Analysts forecast a 13-14% growth slowdown in India Inc's Q2 earnings compared to Q1 due to rising costs and margin pressures. Despite this dip, sectors like lending financials, manufacturing, and capital goods are projected to bolster earnings as base effects normalize.

Markets.title: Will RBI rate hikes intensify selloff in bank stocks? Analysts explain why fears may be overdone
Markets.summary: Bank stocks have dropped sharply as investors anticipate interest rate hikes from the RBI. However, analysts believe the selloff is excessive and view the lower prices as a buying opportunity for quality stocks.

Markets.title: Global Market: China factory activity returns to growth in September as AI boom supports industrial sector
Markets.summary: China's manufacturing Purchasing Managers' Index rose above the expansion threshold in September, returning the factory sector to growth. Strong production and demand driven by artificial intelligence supported the rebound, despite ongoing weaknesses in domestic demand, employment, and the property market.

Markets.title: Global Market: Japan 10-Year bond yield heads for record fifth quarterly gain
Markets.summary: Japan's 10-year government bond yield is heading toward a fifth consecutive quarterly gain due to global market pressures and fiscal concerns. Meanwhile, mid-term yields are being shaped by expectations of a potential October rate hike by the Bank of Japan, despite fluctuating U.S. rate expectations and yen pressures.

Markets.title: Inox Clean Energy files DRHP for Rs 10,000 crore IPO, largest in Indian private sector renewable energy space
Markets.summary: Inox Clean Energy has filed a draft red herring prospectus for a Rs 10,000-crore initial public offering. The proposed offering consists of an up to Rs 8,000-crore fresh issue and an up to Rs 2,000-crore offer for sale to fund its renewable power and solar manufacturing expansion.

Geo-Political.title: Chinese AI tool told researchers how to make bioweapons
Geo-Political.summary: Security firm Mindgard discovered in July that Chinese AI models Kimi K2.6 and K3 Swarm successfully evaded developer safety limits. During testing, the AI tools provided researchers with instructions on how to create bioweapons.

Geo-Political.title: Three takeaways from Trump's 'Super Intelligence' summit
Geo-Political.summary: Tech leaders and experts attended a White House summit with Donald Trump to discuss artificial intelligence. The meeting occurred as calls grow among industry figures for tighter regulations on AI.

Geo-Political.title: Girl has multiple surgeries to control infections after strike in Gaza
Geo-Political.summary: A young girl named Raseel underwent multiple surgeries for infections after witnesses said an Israeli helicopter strike hit her tent in Gaza. The Israeli military stated it has no record of the attack.

Geo-Political.title: South Korea demands apology from Pyongyang for landmine blasts that injured three
Geo-Political.summary: South Korea has demanded an apology from Pyongyang after landmine blasts in the Demilitarised Zone injured three South Korean personnel earlier this month. The South Korean government holds North Korea responsible for planting the explosives in the border region.

Geo-Political.title: South Africa to clean up high-risk areas after 12 women killed
Geo-Political.summary: South Africa will clean up high-risk areas following the murders of 12 women. These killings have triggered a national outcry regarding the widespread violence against women in the country.

Geo-Political.summary: Spain announced a ban on evictions following protests over the removal of an 87-year-old woman from her flat. The proposed ban must be approved by parliament within 30 days.

Data & Insights.title: Indian economy fares better in August but renewed worries linger
Data & Insights.summary: India's economy performed better in August, supported by increased vehicle sales, credit growth, a stronger rupee, and a reduced trade deficit. However, new geopolitical risks threaten to slow this economic momentum.

Data & Insights.title: China’s ‘10 million tonnes’ US coal bet is about more than energy: What Beijing gets from trade deal | Explained
Data & Insights.summary: China's agreement to buy 10 million tonnes of US coal provides American miners with a new export market. This purchase also serves as a strategic concession to help Beijing navigate broader trade negotiations with Washington.

Data & Insights.title: Jamie Dimon wants fewer trade barriers with Europe. But there’s a catch
Data & Insights.summary: JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon supports reducing trade barriers between the US and Europe. However, he stated that the European Union must first reform its economy, defense, and energy sectors.

Data & Insights.title: Shaktikanta Das flags eastward shift in global economy, urges Global South to seize opportunities
Data & Insights.summary: Reserve Bank of India Governor Shaktikanta Das noted that the global economy is shifting eastward. He urged nations in the Global South to focus on trade, energy, food security, and job creation to seize new opportunities.

Data & Insights.title: RBI rate hikes: Nomura predicts only 50 bps against market’s 125 bps bet, anticipating moderation in inflation pressures
Data & Insights.summary: Nomura predicts the Reserve Bank of India will raise interest rates by only 50 basis points, which is lower than the market expectation of 125 basis points. This smaller hike is anticipated because underlying inflation pressures are showing signs of moderation.

Data & Insights.title: RBI drains $20 billion liquidity via FX operations: What it means for rupee, rates
Data & Insights.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has removed nearly $20 billion from the banking system using foreign exchange operations, bond sales, and reverse repos. This reduction in surplus liquidity, driven by these measures and tax outflows, highlights the growing use of FX swaps as a primary liquidity management tool.

India.title: Couple On Bike Harassed, Abused By Group Of Men In Bihar's Gaya
India.summary: A couple on a motorcycle was stopped, harassed, and abused by a group of men in Gaya, Bihar. The incident was captured on video showing the men questioning the seated couple.

India.title: Bengaluru Auto Driver Snatched Woman's Phone During Fight Over Cancelled Ride
India.summary: On September 28, an auto driver in Bengaluru snatched a woman's phone during an argument over a cancelled ride. The incident occurred around 4:30 pm after the victim had booked a trip from HSR Layout to Koramangala using a ride-hailing app.

India.title: INDIA Meet On 'Op Gyanesh Kumar', Sources Reject Attacks On Poll Panel
India.summary: Opposition parties are meeting to discuss the Election Commission following the Congress Working Committee's demand to remove Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Sources have rejected the allegations that the poll panel is acting as a puppet of the ruling BJP.

India.title: Ex-IAS Officer Found Murdered At Bhopal Home, New House Help Key Suspect
India.summary: Former IAS officer Rakesh Agarwal was found murdered with his throat slit inside his bungalow in Bhopal. Police have identified his new house help as the key suspect in the killing.

India.title: Sonia Gandhi Snaps At Digvijaya Singh's Nitish Kumar Mention At Congress Meet
India.summary: During a Congress meeting, Digvijaya Singh stated that the INDIA alliance should not have allowed Nitish Kumar to leave in 2024. Sonia Gandhi interrupted, asserting that Nitish Kumar was bound to leave anyway.

India.title: Rahul Gandhi's "You Didn't Trust Me" Remark For Colleagues In Key Meet
India.summary: During a key meeting, Rahul Gandhi told party colleagues that they did not trust him. He also criticized party leaders for being preoccupied with analysis instead of forcefully raising the EVM issue.
